title: What fertility awareness methods are
answer: Fertility awareness methods help a woman know which days of her cycle she could get pregnant. On those fertile days, the couple avoids sex or uses condoms. answer: The Standard Days Method is for women whose cycles are usually between 26 and 32 days long. Day 1 is the first day of the period. title: What LAM is
answer: LAM stands for Lactational Amenorrhea Method. It is a temporary family planning method based on breastfeeding. When a mother breastfeeds her baby fully or nearly fully, day and night, her body may not release eggs. LAM can protect against pregnancy for up to 6 months after birth, but only if all its conditions are met.
